The 79th Annual Meeting of the Academy of Management was held August 9–13, 2019 in Boston, Massachusetts, USA. Main topic was "Understanding the Inclusive Organization".

The following Conference Proceedings were presented:

- "Winners Earn, Losers Learn? The Effect of New Venture Success on Crowdfunders' Investment Decisions" by Christoph Ihl and Jan-Niklas Wick
- "Copyright or copy right? Unsolicited User Behavior as Market Signals" by Christoph Ihl and Alexander Vossen
- "Contingent Effects of Team Knowledge Diversity on Novelty in Management Research" by Christoph Ihl and Dimitri Graf

The Best Paper Award was given to Christoph Ihl.
